name: Forme SEO AI Agent
author: Calvin Seng

sections.description:
Forme SEO AI Agent connects your WordPress site to the Forme SEO SaaS API so site owners can run SEO audits, generate content plans, review article topics, and track monthly usage from WP Admin.

The plugin includes:

  • SEO health dashboard
  • Website audit workflow
  • Content planner
  • Article topic workflow
  • Reports dashboard
  • Usage tracking
  • Stripe Checkout upgrade flow
  • Stripe Billing Portal subscription management
  • Google Search Console connection support

External Service Disclosure

This plugin connects to the Forme SEO SaaS API hosted at:

https://claude.seo.calvinseng.com

This external service is required for AI-powered SEO analysis, content planning, article topic generation, subscription billing, and account usage tracking.

Data sent to the service may include:

  • Website URLs
  • SEO audit requests
  • SEO metadata
  • Content planning prompts
  • Generated article topics
  • Google Search Console property selections, if connected
  • Billing-related customer identifiers handled through Stripe

The service offers both free and paid plans. Payment details are processed by Stripe and are not stored in WordPress.

Privacy

Forme SEO AI Agent sends requests to an external API service to process SEO audits, content plans, usage data, and optional Google Search Console data.

Payment information is handled by Stripe Checkout and Stripe Billing Portal. This plugin does not store credit card details in WordPress.

Site owners are responsible for informing their users about any external service connections and data processing that may occur.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/forme-seo-ai-agent/, or install the plugin zip from WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Forme SEO in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Create a free account and API key or enter an existing API key in Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an external account?

Yes. The plugin connects to the Forme SEO SaaS API. A free account and API key can be created from the plugin dashboard.

Is payment data stored in WordPress?

No. Payments and subscription management are handled by Stripe Checkout and Stripe Billing Portal.

Can I use the plugin for free?

Yes. A free plan is available with limited monthly usage.

What happens when I upgrade?

The plugin redirects to Stripe Checkout. After payment, subscription status and usage limits are synced through the Forme SEO API.

How do I cancel or downgrade?

Use the Manage Subscription button in the plugin. Cancellation and subscription management happen inside Stripe Billing Portal.
sections.changelog:
1.1.7

  • Fixed roadmap phase parser not recognising bold-markdown phase headings (e.g. Phase 1: …) — phase cards now show items regardless of heading style.

1.1.6

  • Rewrote roadmap phase parser to use line-scanning instead of regex — reliably extracts action items from paragraph-style phase content.

1.1.5

  • Fixed roadmap “Generated” date showing original audit date — now shows when the audit was last run.
  • Fixed roadmap phase cards showing “No items found” when phase content uses paragraph-style text.

1.1.4

  • Fixed SEO Implementation Roadmap phase cards showing “No items found” — parser now handles plain-line phase content from AI audit output.
  • Fixed article topics drawer showing table header row as a topic entry.
  • Fixed Editorial Calendar topics not parsing correctly.
  • Added support for “Four-Phase Roadmap” heading variant in audit reports.

1.1.3

  • Fixed Custom Site URL setting not saving — settings form now correctly sends the site_url field on save.
  • Removed hardcoded article topic caps — Articles page now shows all topics from content plans instead of being limited to 5 or 12.
  • Fixed Editorial Calendar topics not appearing on the Articles page.

1.1.2

  • Added Pro-gated Custom Site URL setting for headless CMS setups (e.g. WordPress on cms.example.com auditing example.com).
  • Locked audit URL to the configured site URL — prevents cross-domain inconsistency.
  • Fixed Google Search Console data gap at month boundaries using a rolling 28-day window with 3-day lag.

1.1.0

  • Locked audit URL to current WordPress site — prevents cross-domain data mismatch in content planning and editorial calendar.
  • Fixed Google Search Console data gap on the first 1–2 days of each month by switching to a rolling 28-day window with a 3-day lag to account for GSC processing delays.
  • Fixed audit report markdown renderer — code blocks now extracted before section stripping, eliminating empty pre elements.
  • Added pipe table rendering in audit reports — markdown tables now display as styled HTML tables.
  • Added inline markdown support (bold/italic) in the audit summary hero.
  • Restored SEO Health Score section display in audit reports.
  • Updated all admin page headers and sidebar menu to Forme SEO AI Agent branding.

1.0.36

  • Fixed markdown renderer operation order to eliminate empty pre elements in audit reports.
  • Added pipe table parsing — audit report tables now render as styled HTML tables.
  • Added inline markdown support in audit summary hero text.
  • Restored SEO Health Score section display in audit reports.
  • Updated all admin page headers and menu to Forme SEO AI Agent branding.

1.0.20

  • Added SEO health dashboard.
  • Added website audit workflow.
  • Added content planner and blog plan workflow.
  • Added article topic workflow.
  • Added reports drawer.
  • Added usage tracking for SEO audits, content analysis, and blog generation.
  • Added Stripe Checkout upgrade flow.
  • Added Stripe Billing Portal subscription management.
  • Added Google Search Console snapshot support.
  • Added API key registration and settings page.
  • Added external service and privacy disclosures.
